> [!PREVIEW]
> `backdown overlaps` isn't in v0.2.0-alpha.4, the current download: it comes with the next preview.


```text
backdown overlaps [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--min <MIN>`
: Only list folders and things with at least this share elsewhere (e.g. 90%). Default: `0%`.

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Examples

```sh
backdown overlaps
# only what is at least 90% elsewhere
backdown overlaps --min 90%
```
